messages:
Aria Bennett: Usability note from todays review: routing policy editor feels dense. Two quick ideas: (1) add a thin index gutter (1..N) so users see positions without relying on badges, (2) introduce a floating mini-toolbar that appears when a rule row is focused (contains reorder, duplicate, delete).

Jon Park: Index gutter is great for scannability. For the mini-toolbar, prefer keyboard-triggered reveal (focus) and hover reveal for mouse. Avoid permanent clutter. Make sure its reachable by touch.

Tara Singh: Accessibility nits: floating toolbar must not overlap the preview controls on small screens. If it would, convert it to an inline row below the rule. Also toolbar icons need visible labels and at least 44px tap targets.

Leo Kim: Validation overlay problem: currently an absolute positioned chip can cover the sim toggle. Suggest converting validation chips into inline helper rows that push content down (or into a dismissible toast if global). In compact mode show a compact helper pill with a "Fix" link.

Aria Bennett: Copy suggestion for helper row: "Missing match condition  Add condition" (action-first). For index gutter tooltip text: "Rule position {n} of {total}" and for toolbar buttons include aria-describedby pointing to that tooltip.

ui-bot: Visual audit: when 8+ rules present, preview control occlusion occurs in 9% of layouts at 375px width. Tap target violations reduced by 60% if floating toolbar switches to inline helper on mobile.

Jon Park: Action items: I'll add index gutter to the comp, show mini-toolbar on focus/hover, and fall back to inline helper on mobile. Tara to draft aria labels and copy. Leo to update validation behavior to inline helper with optional toast for global errors. Review Thurs AM.

Tara Singh: Will do. Suggest aria-live message: "Rule moved to position X" when reorder actions complete. Also include "Preview simulation, on/off" state in the toggle label.

Aria Bennett: Great, thanks team. Uploading updated comps to the design folder and will tag when ready. :white_check_mark:
